# Bash4LLM⁺

> POSIX Bash 4.0+ framework for Large Language Model (LLM) inference, SSE streaming, multi-turn persistent thread contexts, OpenSSL AES-256 encrypted credential management, and an optional FastAPI-based local Web interface.

Operating system environment: Linux, macOS (Darwin), FreeBSD/OpenBSD/NetBSD, WSL, Cygwin/MSYS2, and Termux (Android).

## Runtime Environments & Execution Modes

- **Core CLI Engine & TUI REPL:** Operates strictly on POSIX Bash 4.0+, `coreutils`, `findutils`, `util-linux`, `awk`, `sed`, `grep`, `curl`, and `jq`. Zero external language runtime dependencies (no Python, Node.js, or container engines required for core operation).
- **Cryptographic Security Extension:** Optional AES-256-CBC PBKDF2 vault managed via `openssl` (100,000 iterations).
- **Web Interface Adapter (Optional):** Requires Python >= 3.10 with `fastapi`, `uvicorn`, and `pydantic`. Operates exclusively on loopback (`127.0.0.1`), enforcing single-instance advisory locking and Double-Submit CSRF tokens.

## Security, Vault & Content Sanitization

- [Security Specification (Canonical - EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/SECURITY-en.md): T3 Hardened security model, threat mitigations, and credential isolation invariants.
- [Security Specification (Italian Translation)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/SECURITY.md): Security policy and vulnerability boundaries in Italian.
- [OpenSSL Encrypted Vault Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/security/OPENSSL-HELPER.md): Cryptographic vault architecture (`keys.enc`, `keys.rec`, `keys.dat`), master key wrapping, and RAM session context (`_B4L_RT_CTX`).
- [OpenSSL Helper Module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/security/openssl-helper.sh): Cryptographic engine providing non-interactive vault decryption, offline recovery, and TLS diagnostics.
- [Output Sanitizer Engine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/security/output-sanitizer.sh): Zero-eval stream sanitizer filtering ANSI escape sequences, non-printable bytes, and shell metacharacters.
- [Manifest Generator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/security/generate-manifest.sh): Script generating SHA-256 integrity checksums for all vendor extras modules.
- [Integrity Manifest (SHA-256)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/manifest.sha256): Cryptographic manifest used by `verify_module_integrity` for fail-closed vendor module verification.
- [Integrity Signature](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/manifest.sha256.sig): Ed25519 cryptographic signature of the manifest file.
- [Official Public Key](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/official-ed25519.pub): Ed25519 public key used for manifest signature verification.

---

## Web Interface & GUI Adapter (`extras/gui-py/`)

- [GUI Launcher Wrapper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/gui-py/gui-py.sh): POSIX entrypoint wrapper verifying Python environment, single-instance lock, and invoking FastAPI adapter.
- [FastAPI Main Server Adapter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/gui-py/main.py): REST and SSE server handling session cookies, one-time authentication tokens, and lifespan auto-shutdown.
- [GUI Configuration Dataclass](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/gui-py/config.py): Path resolution resolving canonical `bash4llm.d` runtime directories.
- [GUI Data Models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/gui-py/models.py): Pydantic request schemas and in-memory asynchronous `Job` lifecycle definitions.
- [GUI Security & Process Isolation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/gui-py/security.py): Loopback interface validation, runtime temp directory validation, and kernel-level advisory locks.
- [GUI Async IPC & Subprocess Pipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/gui-py/ipc.py): Deadlock-free asynchronous subprocess execution piping stdin, streaming stdout/stderr tokens, and wrapping Vault IPC.
- [Web Interface Help Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/gui-py/static/help.html): Multilingual static in-app documentation (EN, IT, ES, FR, DE).

---

## LLM Providers & API Adapters (API Contract v1)

- [Providers Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/PROVIDERS.md): API contract, anti-TOCTOU sandbox import, and whitelisted function signatures.
- [Gemini Provider Module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/providers/gemini.sh): Adapter for Google Generative Language APIs (`generateContent`, `streamGenerateContent`).
- [Mistral Provider Module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/providers/mistral.sh): Adapter for Mistral AI chat completion and streaming endpoints.
- [Hugging Face Provider Module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/providers/huggingface.sh): Adapter for Hugging Face Serverless Router (`router.huggingface.co`) and Dedicated Endpoints.
- [Hugging Face Module Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/providers/huggingface.md): Documentation covering endpoint mapping syntax in `hf_endpoints` and interactive CLI helpers.

---

## Session Engine, Storage & Semantic Gates

- [Session Context Engine Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/session/README.md): Multi-turn conversation persistence, segment rotation, and SHA-256 thread anonymization.
- [Session Engine Module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/session/session-engine.sh): Engine implementing N-message sliding windows, token/byte budget accumulation, deduplication, and snapshot metrics.
- [Session Storage Structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/session/struttura.md): Detailed specification of NDJSON record layouts and metadata fields.
- [SML Safety Gate Hook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kamaludu/bash4llm/main/extras/hooks/sml-gate.sh): Post-execution hook validating Structured Metadata Layout v2.0 schema conformance (`LISTEN_SUMMARY`, `CONVERSATION_OUTCOME`).
